mode: BUILD-ONLY DRY RUN. No windows file written, no LLM call made.

edgar_backing.pit_backward_bound: acceptance_datetime (EDGAR acceptance, UTC) <= the decision instant. event_date is NOT the knowability gate.
edgar_backing.pit_forward_window: the calendar month AFTER the decision instant -- `fwd_1m` in the long panel. A SEPARATE variable with a SEPARATE bound; sharing one bound between the two clocks deletes every row.

manifest.coverage_truncation_caveat: the default pull reads only `filings.recent` (~1,000 most recent filings per CIK, all forms); a heavy filer's 8-K history is TRUNCATED at its coverage_start. Absence of a row before coverage_start is truncation, not evidence of no filing. --full-history fetches the older pages.
manifest.survivor_caveat: universe resolved via company_tickers.json = CURRENT registrants; names delisted before the map's fetch date are absent
manifest.pit_rule: availability = acceptance_datetime (EDGAR acceptance, UTC). event_date is when the thing happened; it is NEVER the knowability gate.

edgar_only_why: the EDGAR 8-K tape's own manifest reports filing_date_min 2013-01-02 and its pull params start 2013-01-01. Inside 2010-2013 it holds 6927 filings, in 1 of 4 years (['2013']). An era-replay window needs a cross-section in EVERY month of the era; three of these four years have literally zero rows, so an EDGAR-only build of this era is not thin, it is EMPTY. Two further defects would bind even if the pull were extended: (a) the survivor caveat -- the universe is resolved through company_tickers.json = CURRENT registrants, so presence in 2010-2013 correlates with survival to 2026, the same leak this job already refuses for 2016-19; (b) the truncation caveat -- the default pull reads only `filings.recent`, coverage_start_median is 2016-02-09, so absence before that date is truncation and not evidence. And a third, structural: EDGAR carries no return, so an EDGAR-only bundle cannot be GRADED at all without joining a price tape -- and only 0.0794 of the whole tape's rows even carry a permno to join on.
what_would_make_it_buildable: re-pull EDGAR with --full-history so pre-2016 pages are fetched (the manifest's params show full_history: false), AND
resolve the universe from a POINT-IN-TIME registrant list rather than today's company_tickers.json, or accept and declare the survivorship leak, AND
join a return tape for grading -- EDGAR prices nothing.

panel_backed_alternative.note: NOT an EDGAR-only build. This is the SAME window-build code path (`build_windows(..., dry_run=True)`) run on the long panel for the same era, so the roadmap has a real number for what a second era would cost.

corrected_price.reads: the SAME 846 calls and the SAME token counts, priced by the table on disk today. The sealed receipt's dollars are not wrong -- they are the old table's answer, and the token counts are what was actually measured.

projected_decide_cost.price_table_caveat: gpt-5-nano is priced from this module's LOCAL table {'in': 0.05, 'cached_in': 0.005, 'out': 0.4} because it has no entry in config.LLM_PRICE_PER_MTOK, so the rewriter leg is NOT corrected and remains a lower bound. deepseek-chat is priced from config.LLM_PRICE_PER_MTOK, which is re-read at run time; `corrected_price` says which table that was.

decide_step.enforcement: `assert_decidable` refuses any rewriter or decider wire call whose window month falls outside FROZEN_DECIDE_ERA (2016, 2019). Enforced on the DATA immediately before the wire, not on a CLI flag: no argument combination reaches a provider with a 2010-2013 window.
